profile.name: Hilmi
profile.headline: Network, IoT, Robotics, ML, Cyber Security
about: I have a strong interest in network development, IoT, robotics, machine learning, and cybersecurity, and I am able to work effectively as part of a team.
My work combines technical exploration with a builder mindset: understand the problem, develop a thorough solution plan, execution, test the system, and share what actually works.

research.narrative: I am interested in IoT systems that can sense physical states, autonomously actuate tools or devices, evaluate real-world outcomes, and execute bounded actions with verifiable logs and human-in-the-loop control.

focus.name: Deep Learning
focus.description: Complex data processing, such as images (Computer Vision).

focus.name: Model Deployment
focus.description: apply the model to real-world systems (such as IoT devices or web applications).

focus.name: Software Engineering
focus.description: Design and implement software systems, including web applications and embedded systems.

projects.name: Attendance System
projects.summary: This project demonstrates an integrated approach to attendance tracking using Wi-Fi AP data and two-stage face recognition.

footer: Building thoughtful systems and sharing what works.
